name: Hati

facts.text: Hati is a level-69 named with 30,000 health at the door of Iarnvidiur's chamber, beside Skoll.
He bites (Hati's Bite) and mesmerizes everyone in a 450 radius for 29 seconds.
Allakhazam lists Hati as humanoid, level 65; he drops a moonstone-studded axe.
In Norse myth Hati chases the moon and Skoll the sun until Ragnarok.

story: Hati is the moon-chaser of the old songs, or he is a wolf of Iarnvidiur's brood who was given the name and grew into it. He walks on two legs now, more often than not, and he carries his mother's patience. Where Skoll runs at things, Hati waits for them to fall asleep: his howl is the long silver one, and anyone who hears it close stands dreaming while he bites. The two of them lie at her door like hounds at a hall. They have never caught the moon, and they do not seem to mind.
legend: Hati's mez covers a big circle and lasts half a minute, so keep cure-mez ready and don't stack the casters. Kill him and Skoll before you open Iarnvidiur's door, or they join her. The skalds say if Hati ever catches the moon, the nights will be dark for good.
